sources.title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) Explained
sources.snippet: A technical guide to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). This article covers its core concepts, training pipeline, key alignment algorithms, and 2025-2026 developments including DPO, GRPO, and RLAIF.
